description: Search movies/TV shows on IMDb, fetch by ID, browse charts, or run advanced searches.

genres.description: Filter by genres. Multiple genres are combined with AND. Valid values: Action, Adventure, Animation, Biography, Comedy, Crime, Documentary, Drama, Family, Fantasy, Film-Noir, History, Horror, Music, Musical, Mystery, Romance, Sci-Fi, Sport, Thriller, War, Western.
genres.title: Genres

imdbIds.description: One or more IMDb title IDs (e.g. tt0111161). Used only for byId mode.
imdbIds.title: IMDb IDs (byId mode)

maxItems.description: Maximum number of records to return.
maxItems.title: Max Items

minRating.description: Only include titles with at least this IMDb rating (1–10).
minRating.title: Minimum IMDb Rating

minVotes.description: Only include titles with at least this many IMDb votes.
minVotes.title: Minimum Vote Count

searchQuery.description: Free-text query for search mode (e.g. 'inception', 'breaking bad').
searchQuery.title: Search Query

sortBy.description: How to sort results in advanced/search mode.
sortBy.title: Sort By

titleType.description: Filter results to a specific content type.
titleType.title: Title Type Filter

topRatedChart.description: Which IMDb chart to fetch in topRated mode.
topRatedChart.title: Top Rated Chart

yearMax.description: Include only titles released on or before this year.
yearMax.title: Release Year (max)

yearMin.description: Include only titles released on or after this year.
yearMin.title: Release Year (min)

title: IMDb Scraper Input
